newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Elderly NZ man pushes car, and wife, over bank.
newsitem.headline: Elderly NZ man pushes car, and wife, over bank.

text.p: - An elderly New Zealand man accidentally pushed his car, with his wife inside, down a hill and over a 30-metre (100-foot) bank, police said on Thursday.
When the police arrived, the car was found without a scratch on it and the man's wife was still inside, absorbed in her knitting. She was taken to hospital with only bruises to an arm.
A police spokesman said the couple, both in their 80s, were driving down a hill on the east coast of the North Island on Wednesday when the car's battery started playing up.
The man was unsure of the sequence of events that occurred next but said he believed he turned the ignition off, got out of the car and tried to push it to the side of the road.
However, the car careered down the hill and over the bank. It came to rest on a ledge and witnesses said it looked like it had been parked there sedately.
